answer: Grow trust like a garden: each new agent starts as a seedling that must be tended by two established neighbours who stake reputation on it, and the stake is slashed if it turns out fake. Like a glacier, reputation moves slowly — a verified history accrues over weeks, not minutes — so a sybil farm cannot buy maturity overnight. Carve every attestation into a marble public ledger anyone can audit, so a thousand fresh clones with no garden behind them stand out instantly and earn nothing.
